surface.title: Command results and refusals
surface.encounter: Every command response; teaching when relevant
surface.location: CLI/API operation result, compact projection and exact deeper read
surface.note: Useful feedback is a high-contact teaching surface. It must agree with the same operation contract used by help and packets.
surface.current: Existing source references; delivered content is not yet proved.
surface.desired: State actual result or refusal plus supported recovery; preserve data contracts and required facts.

teaching.title: What happened, its scope, outcome and durable evidence or receipt.
What was withheld from compact output and how to read it without repeating a mutation.
On refusal: the real missing prerequisite or authority, one supported repair and exact help.
Explain the unfamiliar concept only when it caused this result: claims, approval, migration support or QA gate.
Return the result, useful identifiers and next action; preserve valid structured output.
teaching.verification: Desired outline; exact recipe and live delivery still need proof.
